Match.description: A node representing a match in a sports tournament.

Squad.description: A group of people who play a sport together, often for a specific purpose.

Team.description: A team in a sports league.

Tournament.description: A tournament is a structured event where teams compete against each other.

COACH_FOR.description: A relationship indicating that a person is a coach for a squad.

FOR.description: A relationship type that connects a Squad to a Tournament.

IN_SQUAD.description: A relationship between a person and a squad, indicating that the person is a member of the squad.

IN_TOURNAMENT.description: A relationship indicating that a match is part of a tournament.

NAMED.description: A relationship between a team and a squad, indicating that the team is named.

PLAYED_IN.description: A relationship between a person and a match, indicating that the person played in the match.

REPRESENTS.description: A relationship between a person and a team, indicating that the person represents the team.

SCORED_GOAL.description: A relationship between a person and a match where the person scored a goal.

Match.id.description: A unique identifier for the match.

Match.stage.description: The stage of the match (e.g., preliminary, semi-final, final).

Squad.id.description: A unique identifier for the squad.

Team.id.description: The unique identifier of the team.

Tournament.id.description: A unique identifier for the tournament

Tournament.shortName.description: A short name for the tournament

PLAYED_IN.minuteOn.description: The time the person was on the match, in minutes

PLAYED_IN.penaltyScore.description: The penalty score of the match

SCORED_GOAL.minute.description: The minute of the match when the goal was scored.
